name: REDGEOMIN

datum.name: Red Geodesica Para Mineria en Chile

area: Chile - onshore and offshore. Includes Easter Island, Juan Fernandez Islands, San Felix, and Sala y Gomez.
remarks: REDGEOMIN coordinates are updated on a biannual basis identified using syntax "REDGEOMIN([frame]@[epoch]", e.g. REDGEOMIN(IGS20@2024.0), REDGEOMIN(IGS20@2024.5), etc. This EPSG record references any of these updates without distinction. Users should include the update used in the metadata of  their spatial data metadata. Data should be reduced to this epoch using the ADELA deformation model.
